answer_1.quote: InstructDS, the pioneering instruction-following dialogue summarization model. It is a text generation model designed to summarize dialogues while explicitly considering user instructions.
answer_1.outputs: query-based dialogue summaries conditioned on user instructions and dialogue input

answer_2.quote: For evaluation metrics, we include ROUGE 2 , BERTScore (Zhang et al., 2020), human evaluation and ChatGPT (GPT-3.5-Turbo-0301) for comprehensive quality assessment.

answer_3.quote: When using ChatGPT as an off-the-shelf evaluator, we observe that InstructDS is achieving on-pair or better performance over human written summaries on four dimensions.

answer_4.quote: We engaged 12 volunteers, resulting in 792 labeled samples.
answer_4.guideline: The annotator is asked to label the quality of summaries in four dimensions.
